text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Amiodarone increases serum digoxin concentrations by approximately 70% [digoxin:drug_interactions:1, amiodarone:drug_interactions:9]. This occurs because amiodarone inhibits P-glycoprotein (P-gp) [amiodarone:drug_interactions:0], a transporter responsible for the excretion and absorption of digoxin [digoxin:drug_interactions:1]. Consequently, it is recommended to measure serum digoxin concentrations and reduce the digoxin dose by approximately 30-50% when initiating concomitant amiodarone [digoxin:drug_interactions:1, amiodarone:drug_interactions:4].
